name: Leeks (Green Part Only)
siboNotes: Green parts of leeks are well-tolerated and provide fiber without FODMAPs. Safe for most SIBO protocols.
preparationTips: Use only the dark green leafy portions, avoiding white and light green parts
Wash thoroughly between layers to remove dirt and sand
Can be used raw in salads or cooked in soups and stir-fries
Freeze chopped green parts for easy addition to broths
